name: External Image Styles
description: Offload image style derivative generation to external/third-party services by overriding the core image_style config entity with a provider-plugin-driven implementation.
project_description: External Image Styles allows delegation of image style derivative creation to an external service, e.g. a microservice running Glide . Image Styles are still nominally managed inside of Drupal, with provider plugins implementing the necessary glue (back-end HTTP calls, signed URL generation, etc.) for these images to be served without Drupal's further involvement.
